newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-JOCKEY WEAVER RECEIVES 21-DAY BAN.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-JOCKEY WEAVER RECEIVES 21-DAY BAN.

text.p: Leading rider Jason Weaver received a 21-day ban from the disciplinary committee of the Jockey Club on Wednesday.
Weaver had been reported after being found guilty of irresponsible riding at the provincial track of Pontefract 10 days ago. It was his fourth riding offence this season.
Although five days of the ban were suspended until January 1, Weaver will miss next month's big St Leger meeting, including the ride on top stayer Double Trigger in the Doncaster Cup.
Weaver shot to prominence in 1994 when he won the English 2,000 Guineas on Mister Baileys in his first ride in a classic.
